components.name: Primary Capture Button
components.description: Violet, elevated action for logging a completed item or adding a to-do.

components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 9px; min-height: 48px; min-width: 156px; padding: 0 19px; border: 0; border-radius: 12px; background: #6246bc; box-shadow: 0 10px 22px rgba(83, 58, 165, 0.2); color: #fff; font: 700 14px Inter, ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 160ms ease, transform 160ms ease, box-shadow 160ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary svg { width: 19px; height: 19px; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #5336ad; box-shadow: 0 12px 26px rgba(83, 58, 165, 0.27); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(105, 78, 196, 0.28); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(0); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: .48; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Complete To-do Button
components.description: Compact lavender completion action inside a pending row.
components.css: .ds-btn-complete { min-height: 31px; padding: 0 11px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: #f0ecfa; color: #6246bc; font: 700 12px Inter, ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-complete:hover { background: #e6def8; } .ds-btn-complete:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(105, 78, 196, 0.28); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-complete:active { background: #e6def8; }

components.name: Delete Confirmation Button
components.description: Coral destructive action reserved for the confirmation dialog.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { min-height: 42px; padding: 10px 15px; border: 0; border-radius: 10px; background: #ad5848; box-shadow: 0 8px 18px rgba(173, 88, 72, 0.2); color: #fff; font: 700 13px Inter, ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms ease, box-shadow 150ms ease, transform 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-danger:hover { background: #984839; box-shadow: 0 10px 22px rgba(173, 88, 72, 0.27); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(105, 78, 196, 0.28); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-danger:active { transform: translateY(0); }

components.name: Capture Mode Switch
components.description: Lavender two-option control with a white selected segment.
components.css: .ds-mode { display: inline-flex; gap: 3px; padding: 4px; border: 1px solid rgba(105, 78, 196, 0.13); border-radius: 12px; background: #f0ecfa; } .ds-mode button { padding: 9px 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; color: #746985; font: 700 13px Inter, ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-mode button[aria-pressed='true'] { background: #fff; box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(56, 43, 82, 0.1); color: #6246bc; } .ds-mode button:hover { color: #6246bc; } .ds-mode button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(105, 78, 196, 0.28); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Capture Input
components.description: Borderless activity field inside an elevated ivory shell.
components.css: .ds-capture-field { display: block; width: min(100%, 380px); padding: 10px 22px; border: 1px solid rgba(56, 50, 68, 0.11); border-radius: 18px; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.88); box-shadow: 0 20px 50px rgba(38, 31, 55, 0.09); font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-capture-field span { display: block; font-size: 0; } .ds-capture-field input { width: 100%; padding: 13px 0; border: 0; outline: 0; background: transparent; color: #27232d; font: 400 16px Inter, ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-capture-field input::placeholder { color: #aaa5ae; } .ds-capture-field:focus-within { border-color: rgba(105, 78, 196, 0.55); box-shadow: 0 22px 55px rgba(61, 42, 115, 0.13), 0 0 0 4px rgba(105, 78, 196, 0.08); }

narrative.overview:
Daybook treats the workday as a record worth keeping without making it feel like bookkeeping. Calm and capable typography, warm ivory ground, violet decisions, and orderly groups make short notes easy to write and easy to recover. This is an operating interface, not a metrics dashboard.

The forms and panels are softly layered rather than flat or dramatically floating. Controls feel soft and precise: generous enough to invite quick capture, restrained enough to let the entries remain the focus. The one playful gesture is the slightly tilted spark mark; it does not become a decorative motif across the interface.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper-like canvas with translucent white work surfaces.
Georgia headings paired with an Inter-first system sans stack for reading and controls.
Violet for capture, completion, selection, and focus; warm rust for the previous-workday recap; coral for destructive actions.
Rounded, lightly bordered surfaces with a stronger ambient lift around the capture form.

rules.name: The One-Action Rule
rules.body: Use violet for ordinary action and coral only for destructive confirmation; do not give both meanings the same accent.

rules.name: The Record-First Rule
rules.body: Use serif type for the prominent question and section headings; keep entries, dates, controls, and supporting instructions in sans serif so the record scans quickly.

rules.name: The Quiet Elevation Rule
rules.body: Keep resting surfaces subtly separated by translucency and border; reserve noticeable lift for input focus, hover feedback, and modal overlays.

dos: Do keep a clear path from capture to to-dos, today's work, previous workday, and history.
Do use warm surfaces and light borders to separate work areas, reserving the most prominent in-page shadow for the capture form and deeper elevation for dialogs.
Do retain distinct keyboard-focus treatments and the existing reduced-motion behavior when extending controls.
donts: Don't turn the page into a corporate dashboard with dense metric widgets, heavy navigation chrome, or data-viz decoration.
Don't use coral as a general CTA or make ordinary actions look destructive.
Don't replace every row divider with another floating card; the entries should remain the content.
